admission.justification: Spans cli/memory_briefs.py and cli/__main__.py, is guarded by test_memory_briefs_cli_refreshes_briefs_and_refuses_legacy, and supplies the manual recovery path for derived briefs in external memory checkouts.

applicability: Manual derived-brief regeneration invoked via the public agents-remember memory-briefs CLI subcommand.
conditions: Accepts either a configured repository selector (--repo, with optional --config) or explicit converted --memory-root, --code-root, and --coordination-root directories (with optional --code-commit), verifying the converted layout marker before refreshing via refresh_written_memory_folder.
Refuses unconverted legacy memory directories without writing files and emits structured JSON when --json is requested.
exclusions: Creates no Git commit, modifies no authored knowledge/ or onboarding/ files, and is not a mounted MCP tool.
statement: The CLI exposes agents-remember memory-briefs to manually refresh derived briefs for a configured repository or explicit memory/code pair and refuses unconverted legacy memory directories.
title: CLI memory-briefs command refreshes derived briefs and refuses legacy
